profile.name: Sabo

reasons.reason: Há traits ligados ao uso ou à evolução da Skill 2; seu acesso recebe prioridade adicional.

evidence.text: For a set period of time after using Skill 2: Resist Stagger, being Downed, and Knockback.
When using Skill 2 to attack something with HP that the enemy created: Increase damage dealt by 500%. and Reduce the cooldown time of Skill 1 by 5%.

reasons.reason: Capturar tesouro ativa traits. O perfil considera esse benefício além da classe.

evidence.text: When you capture the Treasure: Recover HP by 30%. and Reduce the cooldown time of Skill 2 by 20%.

profile.confidence: perfil com regras de traits reconhecidas

unmodeled.text: When your character is inflicted with Flame Emperor: Boost capture speed by 50%. and Can ignore the enemy and capture the Treasure.
When your character is inflicted with Flame Emperor: Reduce damage received by 30%. and Increase Normal Attack damage dealt by 50%.
When attacking an enemy with Skill 1: Increase the cooldown time of the enemy's dodging by 50%. and 100% recovery of damage given (up to 10000).
Nullify Aflame. and Recover 50% of percentage damage received from an enemy.
When in the area around your enemy's Treasure: Reduce damage received by 30%. and Resist Stagger and being Downed.
Increase damage to enemies with the Element you are strong against by 30%. and Reduce damage received from enemies with the Element you are strong against by 20%.
When the shield you created is attacked by an enemy: Recover HP by 5%. and Reduce the cooldown time of Skill 2 by 5%.

limitations: Pesos e fatores são heurísticos, não oficiais nem medidos em partidas.
Não simula dano final, evolução de skills, mapas, inimigos, troca de classe ou todos os traits.
Traits adicionais não estão equipados neste ranking. Recomendações de atributos são separadas.
Condições usam os fatores gerais 0,5 e 0,25; o cenário real pode mudar a ordem.
Os cinco sets podem compartilhar medalhas: não se força diversidade à custa da pontuação.
